//: The only commands this layer will ever execute. An allowlist of fixed argv, never a shell string: there is no `sh -c` anywhere in runs.mjs, so there is no argument an agent can craft that becomes a second command. A runner that takes arguments declares how they are constrained, and runs.mjs refuses anything the constraint does not accept.
//why-these: Chosen by measurement, not by name. `cd backend && npm test` is deliberately ABSENT: without a live Postgres 13 of its files fail hard rather than skipping (45 failures measured 2026-09-10), so `green` is unreachable and a runner that cannot be green is a runner that teaches agents to ignore it. Per-file `node --test` is safe and is what the verify skill already prescribes.
//tap: Node's test runner prints TAP when its output is piped, which is always here. runs.mjs parses the trailing counters, because a skipped suite exits 0 — reading only the exit code cannot tell `passed` from `did not run`.

preflight.summary: Every gate CI runs on each push, locally. The composite check.

backend-lint.summary: ESLint over backend src and mcp.
backend-lint.note: Exits 0 with warnings by design — there is no --max-warnings in the script. Read the output, not just the code.

backend-architecture.summary: Import-boundary guard plus the two architecture contract tests.

backend-tests.summary: Named backend test files. Per file — never the whole suite.

web-tests.summary: vitest over the Next.js client. No services.

web-typecheck.summary: tsc --noEmit over the web client, the command CI runs inline.

rail-tests.summary: rail-router test suite. Self-contained, ephemeral ports and temp dirs.

ios-build.summary: Compile the app and its test target without booting anything.
ios-build.note: build-for-testing only. The simulator is never booted, and the full TripixTests suite is never run from here — ADR-0001 reserves it for the owner.
